method: AE: project working space None, linearBlending off; 1-px line on black 1024×4, Blur Dimensions horizontal, Repeat Edge Pixels on (GB2), 16 bpc rendered with _HIDDEN X-Factor 16 (16-bit straight PNG). GB2 rows linearized with the measured γ before the σ fit; GB1 rows used as is. Toolbox: blur gaussian, linearize off (its kernel in its own convolution space). σ = least-squares unit-sum sampled Gaussian centred on the line.
